rows.text: The Clearcoat slider controls the B (blue) channel of the spec map. It changes the clear reflective coating/material response, not blue paint. Metalness and roughness are separate channels. This question made no changes.

To keep an authored Solid color and change only its finish, keep the zone in Solid color mode and leave its current color value unchanged; change only the finish control. Do not switch the zone to Source Paint, which uses the loaded image instead of the authored color. This question made no changes.

I cannot guarantee that the finder identifies every logo on an unfamiliar car. It can suggest candidates, but you need to inspect the marked areas and confirm them before relying on the result. Finding a sponsor does not recolor it. This question made no changes.

**How do I keep sponsors and numbers untouched when I change the body**
1. First load your layered PSD: SOURCE PAINT > "PSD/XCF/ORA" (or LAYERS tab > Open Layered).
2. Make a zone for the body and tick only "Car Paint" under RESTRICT TO LAYERS.
3. Or in Chat say "change the body but leave the numbers alone".

Use Save / Open to save and reopen a SHOKK project. It keeps layer state and the current raster pixel payload for layers that have pixels, while recording the source-paint path. The original PSD bytes are not embedded, and original adjustment-layer semantics are not guaranteed. Keep the source PSD available and verify the reopened layers. This question made no changes.
